description: A PostHog dashboard template: a reusable dashboard definition (tiles, filters and variables) that new dashboards can be created from.

LayoutCompaction.description: How tiles rearrange after a move or resize: `vertical`, `horizontal` or `stable`.

Groups.description: Settings for tile groups, keyed by the tiles' group_key, as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString).

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the template belongs to.

DashboardDescription.description: Description given to dashboards created from the template.

DashboardFilters.description: Dashboard-level filters for dashboards created from the template, as JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. {"date_from": "-30d"}.

Tiles.description: Tiles of the template as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString). Each tile is an object such as {"type": "INSIGHT", "name": "Pageviews", "query": {...}, "layouts": {...}, "color": null} or {"type": "TEXT", "body": "..."}.

Variables.description: Template variables as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString), e.g. [{"id": "VARIABLE_1", "name": "Signed up", "type": "event", "default": {"id": "signed_up"}, "required": true, "description": "..."}].

ImageUrl.description: URL of the template's preview image.

Scope.description: Who can use the template: `team` (this project) or `organization` (every project in the organization). `global` and `feature_flag` are reserved for PostHog staff. Defaults to `team`.

AvailabilityContexts.description: Contexts in which the template is offered, e.g. general or onboarding.

Customization.description: Display settings that a dashboard made from this template starts with.
